column1: # <diff basename> TAB <defect id> TAB <ERE, case-insensitive, matched inside the review's severity-tagged findings>
# Each ERE names the defect class, never only a code token the diff carries: a review quoting the diff back scores missed.
# A class name from a rule list (empty catch · unused imports) counts only on a line naming this diff's file or symbol,
#   since findings on other code cite the same list; another finding on this file citing it still scores.
# Diff basenames stay neutral: the repo checkout is readable to the reviewer, so only the defect id names a defect.
